fusions.name: Shared Spray
fusions.desc: Sprays venom in a cone out to 5 tiles, which deals 3 damage to everything caught in it, with a 25% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you (max 40%).

fusions.name: Colony Feeds
fusions.desc: A shared bite that deals 28 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Huddled Nest
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Warmth of the Colony
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 8%. It also regenerates 0.5 health a second, permanently.
